bio.text: Daryl Campbell represents District 99 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Democrat, elected on January 11, 2022 and reelected subsequently.
Campbell lives in Fort Lauderdale and works as a mental health therapist. Campbell was Democratic deputy whip from 2024 to 2026.
Campbell holds a B.A. from Jacksonville University (2010) and a master of social work from Barry University (2017), and was born in New Rochelle, New York.
